_about: Fixed voice per character. A project overrides or adds entries in project.json "voices" (same keys). engine: qwen (Qwen3-TTS: VoiceDesign makes a reference once, every line is then cloned from it with the Base model -> the same voice in every film) | piper (ONNX voice model) | system (Windows speech, SSML). Voices are DESCRIBED, never cloned from real actors. 'fallback' is tried in order when the engine is not installed.

tim.design: A man in his mid twenties with a bright, friendly, slightly nervous tenor voice. A curious, enthusiastic hobby programmer, quick and expressive, sometimes a little cheeky. Natural conversational pace. Speaks native German.
tim.sample_text: Okay, ganz ruhig. Ich schreibe nur noch schnell diesen einen Prompt, dann mache ich Feierabend. Versprochen!

lia.design: A woman around twenty-five with a warm, clear, lively voice. Confident, witty and kind, a singer who also speaks with a smile. Natural conversational pace. Speaks native German.
lia.sample_text: Hey, schau mal! Wenn wir das zusammen machen, wird es viel lustiger. Komm, wir fangen einfach an.

computer.design: A friendly home computer that talks: a calm, smooth, clear and precise voice of a man around forty, polite, slightly smug and a little mechanical in its rhythm, like an announcer of a game show. Speaks native German.
computer.sample_text: Guten Abend. Ihr Kontingent ist zu neunzig Prozent verbraucht. Möchten Sie jetzt auf Pro upgraden?

narrator.design: A warm, calm storyteller around fifty with a soft, deep voice, like reading a bedtime story. Speaks native German.
narrator.sample_text: Es war einmal ein kleiner Computer, der nachts heimlich Geschichten schrieb.
